title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1970-06-24
source: (no source info given- listeners report AUD)

ai_review.summary: Rare audience capture of a ferocious Alligator > Other One jam and standout Attics, but the sound is muddy and uneven.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this show’s wild jams – the Alligator > Other One sequence, multiple Attics performances, a scorching Cold Rain & Snow, and a uniquely sweet second Dark Star – calling it a peak night despite the lack of a proper soundboard. The recording is an audience‑sourced tape with low fidelity, occasional clarity (e.g., a gunshot on Men And My Uncle), and noticeable drop‑outs, yet listeners consider it a valuable historical document.

ai_rating.rationale: The performance is consistently praised as exceptional while the recording quality is uniformly described as poor to fair; the strong musical merit outweighs technical flaws, yielding a high overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Low‑fidelity tape with muddied mids, occasional drop‑outs and hiss. Some moments are surprisingly clear (gunshot on Men And My Uncle), but overall the mix is thin and lacks balance; no soundboard source available.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A wild, improvisational flow with multiple Attics appearances and a powerful Alligator > Other One jam bridging early and late sets; the set feels like a special, almost mythic night despite source confusion.
